title: Anyone have a subway in their mallworld?
content: The subway is a pretty direct contrast to the airport. The airport for me, while a labyrinth, is always golden, full of plants, and is almost like a mall in how many stores and restaurants it has. The subway, by contrast, feels grey and slightly dangerous (to me, nobody else around me seems to think anything is out of the ordinary). It's a giant maze of platforms and trains going seemingly everywhere, and in many places I have to cross over paths on active tracks which again, seems dangerous to me but mundane to everyone else. While I've never boarded a plane at the airport, I have gotten on a train, and they seem to defy the laws of physics, reminding me a lot of the elevators in the hotel. They travel incredibly fast, sometimes at inclines almost like a roller coaster. There's also tracks in the sky, that overlook the massive futuristic city all my dreams seem to be based in.
